title: avenula bromoides var. straminea
intro: Avenula bromoides var. straminea, commonly known as Striped Wood Meadow-grass, is a type of plant that belongs to the Poaceae family. It is known for its therapeutic properties and is used in traditional medicine to alleviate various health issues. The health benefits of Avenula bromoides var. straminea include its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, which can help relieve respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including its ability to reduce inflammation and promote relaxation.
